title: Tandem OLED tech means DisplayHDR 1400 True Black can finally bury Mini-LED for good when it comes to gaming monitors
summary: DisplayHDR True Black 1400 is the latest tier of Vesa's high dynamic range certification standard. Contrast became more important than peak brightness, as you could buy a similarly priced DisplayHDR True Black 400 or True Black 500 OLED panel for less.
